eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Signal, Systems, and Computing for Next-Gen Automation (ICSSCNA) aims to serve as a premier platform for academic and industry professionals to present their latest research, innovations, and technological advancements in the convergence of signal processing, intelligent systems, and computing architectures driving next-generation automation. The conference addresses the transformative impact of AI/ML, IoT, edge computing, and cyber-physical systems on industrial automation, robotics, smart infrastructure, and beyond.
